sections.title: A Chip-scale Space-time Multiplexed Gaussian Boson Sampling Processor Beyond 10,000 Photons
sections.abstract: Chip-scale GBS at 4 GHz with up to 11,059 detected photons in 1 ms and a world-model application.
sections.claimed_result: The authors claim the first chip-scale space-time-multiplexed GBS system.
sections.caveat: Quantum advantage is not established by the abstract alone.

sections.title: High-Temperature ferromagnetism from site-selective filling in (Fe,Ni)6-deltaGeTe2
sections.abstract: A Fe6GeTe2 nano-precipitate is linked to a 478 K Curie temperature.
sections.claimed_result: The authors attribute the high-TC phase to strain-stabilized precipitation and site-specific electronic structure.

sections.title: The Mysterious Inspiral of WASP-12b
sections.abstract: Radial velocities rule out a sufficiently massive companion as the tested explanation for orbital decay.
sections.claimed_result: The companion hypothesis cannot explain the inspiral under the tested scenario.

sections.title: A Multi-Axion Ladder Across Cosmic History
sections.abstract: A multi-axion model gives transient energy components at BBN, before recombination, and late times.
sections.claimed_result: The authors provide benchmark fractions and possible expansion-history tests.
sections.caveat: A model benchmark is not evidence for recurrent dark energy.

sections.title: Universal Structure of Horizon Formation in Generic Binary Black Hole Mergers
sections.abstract: A square-root horizon-branch scaling is derived and recovered in three merger simulations.
sections.claimed_result: The authors claim a universal local structure and a possible waveform signature.
sections.caveat: The observational waveform connection is not demonstrated.

sections.title: Might the radiation era extend back to the Big Bang?
sections.abstract: Quadratic gravity links dark-matter production to a coupling and predicts possible relic-graviton constraints.
sections.claimed_result: The authors propose gravitational dark-matter production and future CMB tests.
sections.caveat: The result is conditional on the radiation era extending to the bang.
